title: Theo and the Vector
author: Mara Nystrom
blurb: Wendell Fairweather, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
